corrections.why: WillhiteWeb says the lookout stood at 5,368 ft, and that the 5,495 ft point is about five minutes further up the ridge. 5,368 ft is about 1,636.2 m. Please check the FFLOS figure before changing the record.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS lists the site at 5,495 ft (1,675 m). WillhiteWeb places the lookout at 5,368 ft and the 5,495 ft point a few minutes further on. The story reports both figures and leaves the choice to the editor.

notes_for_editor: Build (1931) and gone-by (1955) dates agree across sources. Elevation disagrees: the record's 1,674.9 m comes from the 5,495 ft figure, which WillhiteWeb says is a point up the ridge; a correction is proposed for review. The 'today' details and the trail description come from WillhiteWeb trip-report photos dated about 2017. The 1936 staffing comes from a newspaper quote repeated on two sites; no scan was read.
